summary: Fresh direct UBS evidence corrects the queued acquisition to a completed July2022 five-project BMES/700MW deal, not November2021. McAllen's Devco parent, named affiliates and Ironman's ESIF/UBS roles are evidenced, but neither the complete original-five sold-SPV schedule/fifth-asset path nor a complete current ownership after-image is available. Keep the descriptive portfolio task deferred without creating a synthetic company or inferring ratios.
resolvedFormerBlockers: Direct UBS July 28, 2022 announcement proves the completed BMES acquisition of five development-stage ERCOT projects totaling 700 MW. It does not give the five-SPV schedule, separate legal close, legal buyer, stakes or fifth-asset path. The prior November-2021 acquisition conclusion is superseded as a research finding, not silently rewritten in old history.

The December 10, 2021 UBS page concerns team/strategy establishment. The April 14, 2022 FERC document is a petition submitted by UBS, not a Commission finding: its public PDF page 17 says the petitioner was in late-stage investment discussions. The public petition explains fund/GP/adviser roles; confidential organizational exhibits are not present.
The October 2024 UBS insight indeed says six/930 with 2021 timing and four named locations/730. It is not an executed original-project schedule and does not resolve that chronology/capacity mismatch.

PUCT McAllen registration filed November 17, 2025 directly names ESIF Devco LLC as McAllen's corporate parent and identifies five other affiliates across pages 6 and 9. Affiliate listing alone does not establish all affiliate direct/indirect equity percentages or the original BMES acquisition membership.

The prior November-2021 acquisition conclusion is superseded as a research finding, not silently rewritten in old history.

The December 10, 2021 UBS page concerns team/strategy establishment. SMT's direct February 7, 2024 release discloses an unnamed approximately 400 MW sale; its Mission photo is not a sold-asset schedule.
